title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recruitment of children by organised crime
part_text: 8. Urges the adoption of a prevention-first approach and integrated protection systems that are child-centred, gender-responsive, trauma-informed and cross-sectoral, focusing on the early identification of at-risk children, community-based interventions and strengthening families and social services; highlights the positive role of stable families*, sport, educational associations and community organisations in offering safe, healthy and inclusive environments;
